title: Gateway tool flattening
responsibility: Flattens tool namespaces and rejects tools the experimental gateway cannot host.

inputs.name: gatewayToolDefinitions.definitions
inputs.description: Tool definitions containing function/custom entries or namespace entries with a tools array.

outputs.name: gatewayToolDefinitions
outputs.description: Flattened function/custom tool entries with enclosing namespace names attached; direct supported entries are returned unchanged.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when namespace.tools is not an array or a tool type is neither function nor custom.
